**Role Title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Analytics (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge. Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Manager (L9), Enterprise Risk Analytics is an individual contributor role and will be responsible for providing reporting and visual analytics solutions based off the company’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system. This role is a key driver in transforming raw risk data into clear, actionable, and visually compelling reports and dashboards primarily using Tableau. The role will have a dotted line of reporting to the AVP – Enterprise Risk Analytics (US) while directly reporting into the Enterprise Risk Analytics Team in India, which rolls up into Synchrony Financial India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and maintenance of advanced risk reports, dashboards, and visualizations primarily utilizing Tableau based on data extracted from the GRC system and related data sources
* Partner with the eGRC FA and DM teams to understand continuous upgrades and changes to the system and data that can affect downstream reporting
* Collaborate with senior leaders, risk managers, and governance functions to gather, understand, and translate complex business requirements into technical reporting specifications
* Present analytics findings and visualizations to stakeholders, clearly articulating the story behind the data to drive risk-informed decision-making
* Design and build data extracts and queries from the eGRC Data Mart to efficiently support complex risk analytics and reporting requirements
* Perform in-depth analysis of risk data to identify emerging trends, concentrations, and key risk indicators (KRIs) across the enterprise
* Perform other special tasks as needed

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with Tableau
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with one or more data analytics tools like SAS/SQL an Python etc.
* Strong written/oral communication skills.
* Proven ability to deliver Analytical solutions for Business problems.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM related or Business field.
* Experience in consumer credit/risk analytics role
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, organize workflow, and prioritize work assignments
* Working knowledge and experience with GenAI in workspace
* Commercially effective and collaborative across teams and functions
* Intermediate EXCEL skill-set

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.

title: Manufacturing Experienced Professional - Production Planning & Scheduling
description:
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Role Purpose**
The Role will support the Global Drilling Services S&OP organization by transforming complex materials and operational data into scalable, automated, and actionable planning solutions.
  
  
The role will have a particular focus on repairable materials, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory, connecting data across operations, AMO, Manufacturing and regional organizations.
  
  
Rather than relying on manual analysis and individual material reviews, the role will develop automated data models, dashboards and analytics capable of identifying planning gaps, determining inventory requirements and supporting proactive materials decisions at global scale.
  
  
SQL, Power BI and automation will be key enablers of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop scalable analytical models and automated solutions supporting global S&OP and materials planning processes, with particular focus on repairables, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory.
* Connect and analyze data from SAP and other enterprise data sources, including material consumption, scrap, repair activity, circulation hours, installed/available asset population and inventory.
* Develop models to determine appropriate material and sub-assembly requirements based on asset population, historical consumption, utilization, repair behavior and operational demand.
* Build and maintain end-to-end Power BI solutions, including data extraction, transformation, data modeling, business logic, DAX and dashboard development.
* Use SQL to create scalable datasets and analytical models, reducing dependency on manual Excel-based analysis and repetitive data preparation.
* Develop automated planning alerts and exception-management mechanisms to identify material shortages, excess inventory, abnormal consumption, planning gaps and other conditions requiring action.
* Develop and progressively enhance predictive analytics supporting materials requirements and repairable inventory decisions.
* Maintain and improve analytical methodologies such as sub-assembly-to-asset ratios, ensuring planning parameters evolve with changes in fleet size, utilization and operational behavior.
* Improve visibility and control of capitalized inventory, supporting appropriate inventory positioning and utilization.
* Partner directly with Regional S&OP/Planning teams, AMO and Manufacturing to understand operational problems, validate assumptions and translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
* Work independently from an initially defined business problem to investigate data, identify root causes, develop potential solutions and implement sustainable tools with appropriate stakeholder guidance.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate existing manual processes across regions rather than developing isolated local solutions.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to S&OP and operational stakeholders based on the analytical models developed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to extract, combine, transform and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong Power BI capabilities, with demonstrated experience developing solutions end-to-end, including Power Query/data transformation, data modeling, DAX and visualization.
* Experience developing automated and scalable analytical solutions, replacing repetitive manual processes with sustainable data-driven workflows.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous business problem into a structured analytical approach and independently drive the solution with limited guidance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect operational behavior with materials and inventory requirements.
* Ability to work effectively across a global, cross-functional organization, interacting with regional teams, Manufacturing, AMO, S&OP and other functions.
* Fluent English and strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP data and materials-related processes. Deep SAP expertise is not required, but familiarity with SAP environments would be advantageous.
* Experience within Drilling Services, Oilfield Services or another asset-intensive industrial environment.
* Understanding of drilling tools, AMO/repair operations, manufacturing processes, repairables and sub-assemblies.
* Understanding of S&OP, materials planning, inventory management, MRP and/or supply-demand planning concepts.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Power Automate, SAP automation or similar workflow/automation platforms.
